items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: the guiro was Carl the one that then played with Arcano.

ctx.x: Cachao's brother, Cachao was the bass player, and Macho, his brother was the pianist and Manolito was the flute player and Miguelito Valdes was the violin player and the timbales was Barberito and the guiro was Carl the one that then played with Arcano.
Okay, so that's probably why Agadama broke up then, right?
